topics.purpose: Define exact operation, resource, identity/peer, direction and condition bounds for delegated authority.

semantics.direction_rule: Read, write, lifecycle, destructive and onward-delegation permissions are separate.
semantics.condition_rule: Assurance/channel/peer/time/project conditions are explicit where used.
semantics.wildcard_rule: Wildcard delegation is bounded by exact pattern semantics.
semantics.remote_rule: Remote delegation remains narrower/equal to declared delegation regardless of caller's unrelated local rights.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.
